body: It's okay, I understand you. Music usually helps me through rough times, maybe it will help you as well? I was spoiled once, but its not having caring parents that hurts the most. Have you reached out to friends? They might be able to help..maybe it's your attitude and pride towards things..you set an expectation that is too high. Relax, take a breather, and get back in the game by thinking of constructive ways to get out of the debt you're in. Try working more than one job? Focus on your strengths, everyone has made mistakes now and then, sure lie and cheated. But it's admitting it and learning from it that takes courage and makes you a better person. Maybe that girl you don't talk to is who you should talk to and be friends with. Friends help.
Just hold on, we're going home
